A [[wolf]] is a [[charmable animal]] that can be found in [[pre-Searing Ascalon]] and in the [[Southern Shiverpeaks]].

==Locations==
*[[Core]]
**[[The Battle Isles]]
***{{NPC location|Zaishen Menagerie Grounds}} (levels 5, 12, 15, and 20, depending on unlock progress)
**[[Ascalon (pre-Searing)]]
***{{NPC location|Lakeside County: 1070 AE}}
*[[Guild Wars Prophecies|Prophecies]]
**Ascalon (pre-Searing) (level 2)
***{{NPC location|Lakeside County}}
***{{NPC location|Regent Valley (pre-Searing)}}
***{{NPC location|Wizard's Folly}}
**[[Northern Shiverpeaks]] (as "Snow Wolf")
***{{NPC location|Anvil Rock}}
***{{NPC location|Iron Horse Mine}}
***{{NPC location|Traveler's Vale}} (right outside [[Yak's Bend]])
**[[Southern Shiverpeaks]]
***{{NPC location|Lornar's Pass}} (as "Snow Wolf")
***{{NPC location|Spearhead Peak}} (level 15 [[Elder]] Wolf; see notes)

==Missions==
*Northern Shiverpeaks (as "Snow Wolf")
**{{NPC location|Borlis Pass}} (a short way from the start)
**{{NPC location|The Frost Gate}} (after the first bend)

==Notes==
*Unlike most charmable animals, Wolves in pre-Searing Ascalon are not [[passive]].
*Wolves deal [[slashing damage]].
*A level 15 charmable Elder Wolf may appear near [[Thul The Bull]] in [[Spearhead Peak]]. It will turn hostile when the player approaches, but can be charmed anyway if no Stone Summit are nearby to charm it before.
*[[Zaishen_Menagerie_Grounds/Service_costs|Unlocking cost]]: 1{{zsilver}} plus 100{{gold}} or 1,000 [[Balthazar Faction]] ''(Common, Tyria)''
**[[PvP-only character]]s will get a level 20 Elder Wolf the first time they equip [[Charm Animal]], due to this, a player can unlock this pet in the Zaishen Menagerie simply by creating a PvP-only character.
